title: Simmons First National Corporation Declares $0.215 Per Share Dividend
summary: Simmons First National Corporation (NASDAQ: SFNC) (Simmons or Company) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend on Simmons' Class A common stock of $0.215 per share, which is payable on October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026. The cash dividend rate represents an increase of 1 percent from the dividend paid for the same time period last year.

title: Lisa Hunter to Retire After 30 Years at Simmons Bank
